The problem

The world is full of NPCs.

Same layout. Same copy. Same trust badges. Scroll past one and you've scrolled past a thousand. Being one of them isn't a design problem — it's a story problem.

What you've been handed
  • A template wearing a coat of paint
  • Copy that says a lot and means nothing
  • Forgotten the moment it loads
  • One of a thousand
What you're meant to be

  • A story worth following
  • People who come back
